android-data-display|Tree.summary: Plenix on Android shows a library’s folders the way the web’s file browser does: a tree of folders in a list, each row an expand control, the folder icon and its name in DM Sans, the open folder in the selected fill, and its contents beside it on a large screen (a list-detail layout) or as the next screen on a phone, where the path above the list leads back. Material 3 has no tree component; Plenix builds it from list items with Material’s expand and collapse, its touch targets and TalkBack’s expanded state, and changes the look: Plenix colors, DM Sans and DM Mono, the Plenix row height and the line between rows. Files move by dragging them onto a folder (a long press) or with Move to in the row’s menu.

compose: fun PlenixFolderRow(folder: Folder, depth: Int, selected: Boolean, expanded: Boolean, onToggle: () -> Unit, onOpen: () -> Unit) {
if (folder.children.isNotEmpty()) IconButton(onClick = onToggle) { Icon(if (expanded) Icons.Filled.ExpandMore else Icons.Filled.ChevronRight, contentDescription = null) }
Icon(if (selected) Icons.Filled.FolderOpen else Icons.Outlined.Folder, contentDescription = null, tint = PlenixColors.contentMuted)
